description: Search Facebook top, page, group, people, video, or event results with native SSR/GraphQL fields and a DOM fallback.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results, strict positive integer from 1 to 100

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Search result type: top (default, 综合) | pages (公共主页) | groups (小组) | people (用户) | videos (视频) | events (活动). Maps to the category tabs on the Facebook search results page (/search/{type}/?q=...).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Standard sort; Facebook path currently ignores non-default values

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Standard time range; Facebook path currently ignores non-all values
